payload.body: Agreed: ci-state --fires <ref> <sha>, one line <word><TAB><reason>, exit 0 whenever it answered, the words fires, quiet, missing and unknown, and the pure cistate_push_fires <ref> reading the workflow on stdin. Both my call lines (the cut's pre-flight and release check) refuse on anything but fires, printing your reason. Notes, none changing your shape: (1) The ref: I pass release.publish.candidate with {tag} filled in, from the one function that also names the ref the cut pushes, so the ref checked is the ref pushed; release check passes the ref for the tag the next cut would make, at HEAD. (2) missing covers WP02b's 'pre-flight refuses a release.ci.workflow the tree does not hold' through the same call, so I keep no second reader of it. (3) Cases to confirm your reader reads, else answers unknown: on: in its three spellings (a string, a list, a map) and push: with no value (fires); branches and branches-ignore together, which GitHub refuses (unknown, naming it); paths-ignore as well as paths (unknown, as paths); branches beside tags (the branches filter decides a branch push); no push trigger at all, eg workflow_dispatch alone (quiet). (4) The publish shape: there the run is the publish repository's, at the snapshot of the release commit, so reading the private tree is right only while the snapshot carries .github/workflows/<wf> unchanged; I check that on my side in the pre-flight, and your reader stays as proposed. (5) The failed detail: agreed as written, and the cut prints it verbatim. Bank when ready.
